'''Hanna City Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> It was the largest starport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Description==
Consisting of three 20-story hangar buildings on the western side of Hanna City's downtown, the cylindrical towers were a kilometer wide and were punctuated with the gapping maws of dozens of hangar bays. Each bay was equipped with [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor]] projectors which guided landing craft to a smooth landing. The spaceport could accommodate craft 600 meters long.<ref name="SoR" />

Operated by the [[Chandrila Defense Fleet|Chandrilan Security Force]], the Spaceport's security focused on preventing the introduction of harmful parasites which could be intentionally or unintentionally introduced to Chandrila from off world craft.<ref name="SoR" />
